coordinate_policy.bearing_mounts: bearing coordinates are local to their linked joint/link frame, not global
coordinate_policy.part_mass_properties: center of mass and inertia tensor are expressed in the part/link local frame unless source_frame says otherwise

runtime_targets.bearing_health_bridge: firmware TTL bridge for browser bearingLoads and robot bearing health
runtime_targets.actuator_derating_engine: motor current, controller temperature, motor temperature, and bus-voltage derating seed
runtime_targets.actuator_health_bridge: firmware TTL bridge for browser jointLoads and robot actuator health
runtime_targets.structural_allowables_engine: browser-side seed design allowables and fatigue screening from material family policies
runtime_targets.structural_health_bridge: firmware TTL bridge for browser structuralChecks and robot structural health
runtime_targets.process_feed_planner: browser-side process mode feed clamp and safety requirement seed
runtime_targets.prr_axis_contract: 3-axis PRR SCARA actuator and CANopen seed map for Teensy motion ownership

runtime_overrides.browser_material_overrides: CAD context-menu selections are stored in browser localStorage as mros_kin3d_material_overrides and do not rewrite CSV defaults
runtime_overrides.browser_payload_profile: Active payload is stored in browser localStorage as mros_kin3d_active_payload and can be changed with window.kin3d_setActivePayload(payload_id)
runtime_overrides.browser_actuator_telemetry: Actuator thermal/current telemetry is stored in browser localStorage as mros_kin3d_actuator_telemetry and can be changed with window.kin3d_setActuatorTelemetry(joint_id, telemetry)
runtime_overrides.browser_process_mode: Active process mode is stored in browser localStorage as mros_kin3d_active_process_mode and can be changed with window.kin3d_setActiveProcessMode(mode_id)
